title: Provision the demo Engineer through Boss Admin
verify: Independent browser verification covers direct Engineer creation, non-Boss denial, Engineer login, and write-only password handling only.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-012 / REQ-020 RED: no Boss browser path can directly create the demo Engineer; GREEN: an isolated Boss creates one Engineer through Boss Admin HTTP, the Engineer authenticates, non-Boss creation fails, and password/auth material is absent from response, page state, logs, storage, and capture input; decisive comparison: browser/API/auth transcript plus configured corpus scan; artifact: provisioning evidence under .tasks/TASK-082-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose only direct Engineer provisioning required by the first demo while identity and password authority remain in Access & Admin.
success_outcome: A Boss can create the demo Engineer through the registered backend action, the Engineer can authenticate, non-Boss creation is denied, and password/auth material remains write-only.
anti_goals: Do not add invitations/email, recovery, enterprise identity, role reassignment, Plant/grant management, audit presentation, or frontend-owned authorization state.
Do not retain the initial password in page state, logs, browser storage, or captures.

forbidden_scope: backend Account, Membership, PlantAccessGrant, and audit authority
new identity, role, or permission semantics
stop_conditions: The UI requires a backend route or permission outside registered Boss Admin/Plant Management contracts.
A safe Boss journey cannot be completed without exposing or retaining password/auth material.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Access & Admin remains the only Account, Membership, password, and audit provider.
Use registered request fields and stable safe backend errors only.
invariants: The provisioning UI cannot assign Plant access, bypass role rules, or create authority from notices.
Password and auth material never enter page data, logs, audit text, browser storage, or captures.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-012: exact direct Engineer provisioning and authentication with non-Boss denial.
FT-016-AC-012 / REQ-020 T3 harm proof uses isolated Accounts and confirms no password/auth residue after safe rerun cleanup.
